To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effect of polymer blending can be quantified by molecular modeling of cyanurate polymeric materials.
the effect of polymer blending can be predicted from the molecular modelling of cyanurate polymbers.

(i) the properties of blends of cyanurates can be predicted from the properties of the individual constituents; (ii) the properties of the blends are not simply additive, and (iii) molecular modelling can be used to predict the properties of blends from first principles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular design of polymer blends and the prediction of the properties of the resulting polymer blends.
the molecular modelling of polymers, and more particularly with the prediction of the physical and chemical properties of polymers from first principles.
the development and application of molecular modelling methods to the study of polymer blends.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work shows that the molecular modelling of polymers is a useful tool in the design of new polymers and polymer blends.
the properties of polymer blends can be predicted from molecular modelling to a good level of accuracy.
the properties of the blend are not simply the sum of the properties of the components but are determined by the interaction between the two components.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the molecular modelling approach can be used to understand the behaviour of polymer blends and to predict properties.
molecular modelling can predict the properties of polymer blends with sufficient accuracy and speed to be of practical use in the polymer industry.
we have developed a methodology that can be applied to the prediction of polymer blends.
The main takeaway from our work is that
molecular modelling is a powerful tool for predicting the effect of polymer blending.
the properties of a blended system can be determined from first principles modelling of the individual components and their interaction with each other, provided the molecular models are accurate.
the properties of polymer blends can be predicted with a good degree of confidence by using a molecular modelling approach.
